scope: Validator preflight failure; no camera pipeline was started.
cause: The Windows virtualenv python.exe redirector launches the real interpreter as a child; checking only the wrapper PID did not find the listening socket.
correction: Check the spawned process and its descendants for listener ownership before controlling the isolated API.
cleanup_observation: After the validator exited, port 8779 had no listener. The production server on 8000 remained running.
